# Leonardo Dev Portfolio

Personal portfolio for Leonardo Soares Tavares, featuring selected software and web projects.

## Rikka engineering case study

- URL: https://www.leonardodev.fun/projects/rikka/
- Rikka is a Discord card collection platform composed of a bot, game-domain services, a custom catalog, an API, administration tools, background workers, an administration bot, and a public website.
- The case study discusses materialized search/drop indexes, validated catalog snapshots, asynchronous cross-domain consistency, recoverable administration processing, and transactional integrity.
- The operational core is private. Only the public website repository is linked from the portfolio.
